summary: One decision is needed before the failure path can be specified.

questions.question: What should the user see when delivery fails?
questions.why: The user needs to know whether to retry without creating a duplicate.
questions.details: The issue describes successful delivery but does not define the failure screen.
questions.recommendation: Keep the submitted information and show a retry action.
questions.justification: This lets the user recover without re-entering information or accidentally submitting twice.
options: Keep the information and offer retry
Clear the form and ask the user to start again
